// diagnostic

E0928

A `#Job fn` collides with a reserved lifecycle/CLI name or another job in the same scope (D-JPK-TASKRUN1, D-JOB-SUBCMD1, D-CMD-OVERRIDE1=C)

What

A `#Job fn` collides with a reserved lifecycle/CLI name or another job in the same scope (D-JPK-TASKRUN1, D-JOB-SUBCMD1, D-CMD-OVERRIDE1=C)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0928

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0928: tests/ui/task_reserved_lifecycle.stderr.

Error [E0928]: `test` is a built-in lifecycle verb, not a job name
  --> tests/ui/task_reserved_lifecycle.jet:4:1
    |
  4 | #Job fn test() {
    | ^^^^
 Why: `run`, `dev`, `build`, and `test` already name Jet's built-in entry points — a `#Job fn` picks a user-chosen verb beside them (D-JPK-TASKRUN1/D-CMD-OVERRIDE1=C).
 Fix: rename it, e.g. `#Job fn test_assets()`, or drop `#Job` if this is the lifecycle entry.
reserved: run, dev, build, test
